description: Figure 2 is a line plot that compares the reliability scores of individual models versus ensemble models. The x-axis represents different models, including GPT-4 + Opus, FT GPT-3.5 + GPT-4, FT GPT-3.5 + Opus, and All. The y-axis represents the reliability scores, with two subcategories: RS0 and RS10. The line plot shows that ensemble models generally have higher reliability scores compared to individual models. The plot also includes a table that provides the reliability scores of ensemble models, with the highest score being 98.34% for the Two Embeddings Few-Shot + Column Values prompt type.
